نرتبط (form VIII)
# نَرْتَبِطُ (nartabiṭu) /nar.ta.bi.tˤu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِرْتَبَطَ (irtabaṭa)
# نُرْتَبَطُ (nurtabaṭu) /nur.ta.ba.tˤu/: first-person plural non-past passive indicative of اِرْتَبَطَ (irtabaṭa)
# نَرْتَبِطَ (nartabiṭa) /nar.ta.bi.tˤa/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِرْتَبَطَ (irtabaṭa)
# نُرْتَبَطَ (nurtabaṭa) /nur.ta.ba.tˤ
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
